nameJa: 配信コミュニティ・ポスター
headline: WATCH. REACT. REPLY.
prompt:

ONE entire finished original promotional tile for YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen browser extension. Exact preferred canvas1760x1120, compact wide11:7 ratio1.571 like440x280. No ultrawide panorama. Not a real screenshot. Modern independent music/fan-community poster aesthetic.
Art direction: acid yellow #e8ff2b dominates, charcoal-black #171718, pure warm red #ff3b30 accent, cream few highlights. Crisp flat graphic printing, restrained gritty ink texture, expressive brutalist condensed typography, like a very cool music festival/fan-zine poster. Strong diagonal motion and clever silhouette shapes, NOT infantile cartoons and NOT enterprise SaaS.
Composition: Giant expressive condensed black heading exactly "WATCH." then "REACT." then "REPLY." at left, stacked with slight offset, huge legible type nearly full-heightleft55%, energetic assertive typography. Tiny extension name at top-left exactly "YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen". Right side and across lower middle: ONE simple wide full-screen stream field represented by a flat charcoal rectangle with FOUR contrasting yellow fullscreen corner brackets, set just slightly off-axis for energy. Inside this stream field show an ORIGINAL abstract red/cream concert stage: simple beam shapes, one tiny silhouetted performer, minimal audience shapes. No physical display, no computer, no browser frame. At the RIGHT edge INSIDE this same stream field place ONE warmcream live chat panel with black outline and4short chat messages exactly "LET'S GO", "that drop!", "W", "again!". Clear input at bottom exactly "Say something..." with red send-arrow. Chat overlaid on stream field must be visually obvious and no second chat panel.
A few large stylish flat expressive smile/speech-bubble/lightning glyphs in black/red around OUTSIDE edges of the field, original simple graphics, no emojis or faces copied from any known brand. Be playful but grown-up. Clear hierarchy: iconic huge type, one stream, one chat/input, strong accent shapes. Sparse enough to read at440x280, all content safe from crop. No extra copy, no realstreamer identities, Chrome/YouTube logos, ratings, status badges, desk/room/monitor, stacked windows, darkgradient, glossy3D, rainbow clutter or charts.
